brief:
A Channel 4 investigation reveals how the UK Foreign Office repeatedly failed to hold the Israeli army accountable for alleged war crimes in Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The film presents new evidence of British complicity in what pro-Palestinian activists describe as genocide.

The documentary examines the Foreign Office's response to documented violations during the Gaza conflict, raising questions about Britain's diplomatic role and enforcement of international law.
dek: How the Foreign Office veiled Israel's crimes in Gaza to keep British arms flowing Submitted by Peter Oborne on Fri, 10/02/2026 - 19:32 Channel 4 investigation shows how the UK government repeatedly failed to hold the Israeli army to account for war crimes…
title: Channel 4 documentary examines British government's Gaza accountability failures
